caption: swipe for the week the sky had, jan 18 to today. tomorrow the sun meets pluto.

slides.headline: what just happened in the *sky* this week?
boundaries got *easier* to say
slides.body: clear talk with no drama. if you said no to something on monday, it probably landed fine.

slides.headline: *aquarius* season started
slides.body: the sun left capricorn. then it trined uranus on thursday: a week for unexpected plans.

slides.headline: the *leo* full moon took the mic
slides.body: read it as the week's confession night. if you said it, good. if you didn't, the moon is not the only chance.

slides.headline: the *follow-up* text had good weather
slides.body: kind words came easier. hope you sent one.

slides.headline: the sun meets *pluto* on monday
slides.body: once a year the sun passes pluto. astrologers read it as the truth with the lights on. more tomorrow.

slides.headline: you said it. now *let it land*.
slides.body: save this. the week ahead lands tomorrow.
